_description: LoW (Lord of War), single-player version (low.py; roadmap Stage 4). Wiki (belgeler/arastirma/pve_icerik.md 2.9, darkorbitwiki.com/galaxy-gates/low): portal on X-3, group gate (at least 3 players). Aliens and their counts from the wiki (LoW versions: npc.json 90-97, npcId 42-48 and Century Falcon 120): Vagrant 14, Marauder 17, Outcast 18, Corsair 10, Hooligan 17, Ravager 17, Convict 16; when all are dead the four relay stations are activated in order, after the fourth Century Falcon arrives with the Vagrants. Rewards are the aliens' own rewards: the wiki's single-player total (7,002,000 EP, 26,400 honor, 35,400 U, 35,355,000 credits) is their sum. After everyone dies you can return within 5 min. Layout (player report #13, 2026-10-26): the entry is in the map's lower left corner (map_links.LOW_START (1000, 11800): wiki "lower left corner", emu-dark LowPortal.cs); four relays at fixed places (role.places: emu-dark CreateRelayStation, the same areas as the green squares numbered 4, 9, 11, 13 in the wiki image), the first visible from the entry, each appears when the previous one is activated; the HQ is in the middle of the map (decorative station map_links.LOW_STATION, the boss spawns here; emu-dark CreateHealthStation (10400, 6400), the official recording the middle of the map); the red no-fly zones are in the 200 entry of map_layout.json (NO_ACCESS, aliens pass). Narration: the client's transmission_groupgate_* texts (radio from HQ; narration).
_adaptation: Aliens come wave by wave in order by type (not all 109 at once). The relay station fills by shooting it (wiki "shoot the station until its green indicator loads", the client's transmission_groupgate_relay_station_2 text; the damage needed to fill is 300,000, adaptation; selecting and shooting the relay in the client was verified live): as a fallback it also fills when you stay next to it (radius) for sec seconds. While there are pirates on the map (including the relay's defenders) and before the relay's turn, the relay does not activate (the client's msg_groupgate_cant_activate_relay_because_npcs_are_alive text; official forum LoW redesign: "all NPCs must be killed for the next relay to open"). Vagrants are the wiki's 14: 4 in a wave, 1 defender at each relay, 6 as Century Falcon's escort. When done, a return portal to the company's X-3 in the middle. Route: the numbers in the wiki image give the order (1 start; 2, 3 spawn; 4 relay; 5, 6 spawn; 7 HQ; 8 spawn; 9 relay; 10 spawn; 11 relay; 12 spawn; 13 relay; 14 boss) and the 7 spawn points match the 7 alien types in number; which type spawns at which point is not in the source (ADAPTATION: wave order, wave i = i-th spawn point; the route places the relays in between according to this order). The coordinates of the spawn points (spawn_points) were derived from the wiki image (664x492, scaled to 21000x13100), approximate (±500-1000), point 6 is next to the HQ; instead of spawning when the player approaches (fandom "when approaching the area") they spawn when the previous wave dies. A relay defender spawns in a ring around the relay (spawn_distance). HQ healing zone: the client's transmission_groupgate_relay_station_bypassed text ("the first relay triggers the HQ repair zone, fly to the zone and repair your ship"), wiki "speeds HP regeneration in the middle of the map", official forum FAQ (heals while fighting too); radius 1200 from the green circle in the wiki image (~1000-1200); independent of the repair robot. NUMBERS WITHOUT SOURCE: heal_hp_per_sec 5000 (wikiwiki.jp "5,000, some 20,000"; unit unclear, the low value was taken as HP/s), relay_increase 0.25 (each additional active relay +25%; from the old "repair 25%" adaptation). Pirate missiles (fandom Group Gate FAQ: "pirates also fire missiles") were not added: the source gives no type, damage or cooldown value. The 3-player requirement is deliberately absent (single-player).

role._pirates: when the 2nd-4th relay is activated, a pirate group around the relay (official Turkish forum 126411); type and count are an adaptation

_exit: When Century Falcon dies everyone is sent to their company's X-1 station (official Turkish forum 126411); replaces the old X-3 portal.
